capture.notes: StableDiffusionPipeline calls with DDIMScheduler or LCMScheduler, the same prompt and seed; the LoRA is loaded with load_lora_weights and merged with fuse_lora. Hooks only observe, and an unhooked 4-step call gives the identical image. SD 1.5's U-Net is kept as a copy from before the LoRA was loaded and run on the 4-step run's own inputs. Maps are the RMS over channels at each pixel. Previews are 128 px JPEG decodes by the pipeline's own VAE.
